recovery_vehicle.definition: The van or truck sent to collect the car. Some can lift a car and some can only tow it on a wheel.
recovery_vehicle.example: The recovery vehicle will lift the car, so I do not need to empty the boot.

sleep_onset_latency.definition: The time between getting into bed and falling asleep. Under about twenty minutes is normal.
sleep_onset_latency.example: My sleep onset latency is about forty minutes, most nights.
